cause: NaN compares false at every original threshold, allowing unavailable validation metrics to pass release; favorable infinite values could also pass.
change: All four release metrics must be finite; any NaN or +/-Inf rejects release with a field-specific reason. Nonnegative-strata fraction must lie in [0,1].

validation.cases: Ordinary PASS and exact boundaries; original finite FAIL conditions; each metric NaN/+Inf/-Inf; all four unavailable; invalid fractions; existing public/error triggers.

scope: Release validation and semantic test only; no algorithm or model change, broader tests or data access.
